key_facts: XPeng is skipping Level 3 autonomous driving entirely, citing fundamental flaws in the human handoff requirement and insufficient hardware/software/regulatory readiness.
Its second-generation Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation model — unifying perception, reasoning, and action — is rolling out to all Ultra and UltraSE models this month.
XPeng merged intelligent cockpit and AD units into a single AI Center to treat the vehicle as a cross-domain AI agent.
CEO He Xiaopeng claims internal benchmarks show XPeng is ~5x ahead of top peers in autonomous driving; targets full L4 (geofence-free, driver-out) in 1–3 years.
analyst_angle: XPeng’s L3 skip signals a strategic pivot toward foundation-model-native autonomy — prioritizing generalization over incremental ADAS — potentially reshaping industry R&D priorities away from regulatory-compliant L3 intermediaries toward end-to-end AI agents.

key_facts: 论文标题为《Real Money, Fake Models: Deceptive Model Claims in Shadow APIs》
揭示了影子API（Shadow APIs）中存在模型能力虚假宣传问题，即服务商实际调用的模型远弱于其声称的SOTA模型（如GPT-4、Claude等），却向客户收取高价
analyst_angle: 该研究首次系统性揭露AI服务供应链中的‘模型套壳’欺诈现象，将推动API透明度标准建立和企业级AI采购尽职调查升级。
